course.name: Templates, Packages & the Store
course.description: Evaluate a dependency and reuse a tested Flow as a versioned template.
course.longDescription: Prerequisite: Thinking in Flows or an existing tested Flow. Use Desktop for local package management; registry browsing needs network access. Core: 20 minutes. Optional sharing and publication planning: 12 minutes; those classes require an online App and suitable permissions. Create a template and verify its behavior in another Flow. Checks are manual.

challenges.prompt: A package exists in your device Library, but a practice App does not expose its nodes. What should you inspect next?
challenges.explanation: The App’s dependency declaration is separate from the device installation.

options.label: The App’s package dependency and linked version
The App’s theme
The source Flow’s canvas position

lessons.title: Review a dependency before linking it

challenges.prompt: A formatting package asks for unrestricted network access. What is the next step?
challenges.explanation: Evaluate declared access against the package’s intended behavior and evidence.

options.label: Assume a high rating explains the permission
Grant it because the node has a short name
Check why that access is required before installing

challenges.prompt: A template created from Latest in June lacks a July fix. What should you do?
challenges.explanation: Latest is captured when the template is created; template versions do not follow later draft edits.

options.label: Rename the June template
Add a newer tested snapshot as a template version
Wait for the June snapshot to update itself

challenges.prompt: A partner may receive a table schema but no records. Which fork database option matches that requirement?
challenges.explanation: Tables-only copying preserves structure while creating empty tables.

options.label: Tables only
Tables and data
All private User Storage

challenges.prompt: Changing the App’s display version to 2.0 does what?
challenges.explanation: The display label documents a release; Flow snapshots and Event targets are separate controls.

options.label: Creates immutable versions of every Flow
Repoints every Event automatically
Updates release metadata

challenges.prompt: The reused graph needs a provider credential from the source App. What must the recipient do?
challenges.explanation: A template does not carry source App runtime credentials.

options.label: Copy the secret into the public description
Configure its own supported runtime credential
Expect the template to contain the secret

challenges.prompt: The new project needs the revised format, while older projects must keep theirs. What fits?
challenges.explanation: Versioned snapshots let consumers adopt a revision deliberately while earlier versions remain available.

options.label: Add and test a new template version for deliberate selection
Overwrite every existing copy
Change the old template’s name only
